skills.name: Airtable
skills.summary: Spreadsheet-like databases with views, forms and automations, in the browser.
skills.author: Teachy
skills.headline: Find your way around Airtable bases, views and automations.
skills.description: For anyone handed an Airtable base who needs to add fields, build a view or a form, or work out why a filter changed for the whole team.
highlights: Where views, filters and sorts live, and who sees them
Adding and editing fields, including links between tables
The gotchas that delete data in every view

skills.name: Canva
skills.summary: Design tool for social posts, presentations and documents, in the browser.
skills.author: Teachy
skills.headline: Resize, edit and export Canva designs without hunting for buttons.
skills.description: Turn this on when you are editing a template, resizing a post for another platform, or trying to get a clean download.
highlights: The editor layout: object panel, page, selection toolbar

skills.name: Discord
skills.summary: Chat servers with text and voice channels, the same in the desktop app and the browser.
skills.author: Teachy
skills.headline: Servers, channels, voice and settings in Discord, mapped out.
skills.description: For people new to Discord, or anyone looking for where invites, screen share or per-server profiles are.
highlights: Server list, channel list and member list explained

skills.name: Linear
skills.summary: Issue tracking for software teams, the same in the desktop app and the browser.
skills.author: Teachy
skills.headline: Move fast in Linear: issues, cycles, filters and shortcuts.
skills.description: For engineers and PMs working in Linear who want the single-key shortcuts without typing into the wrong issue.

skills.name: Obsidian
skills.summary: Markdown notes stored as plain files in a folder (a vault) on your Mac.
skills.author: Teachy
skills.headline: Notes, links and plugins in an Obsidian vault.
skills.description: For anyone starting an Obsidian vault, linking notes, or turning on community plugins.
highlights: Why renaming in Finder breaks links

skills.name: Zoom
skills.summary: Video meetings. Covers the Zoom Workplace app's home window and the meeting window.
skills.author: Teachy
skills.headline: Run a Zoom meeting without hunting through the toolbar.
skills.description: Turn this on before a call: picking a mic, sharing a window with sound, recording, and where a host's controls are.
highlights: The home window and the meeting toolbar
